summary: Tested full Women's Shield → Head Out → Guardian Share flow. All critical checks PASSED. The guardian-share screen loads correctly after tapping 'Notify your guardian', shows the journey card with destination and check-in time, and the message preview contains '[status link will be added]' placeholder. Empty trusted circle shows the 'Add contacts' state with 'Set up trusted circle →' link. No crashes observed.

observations: The 'women-entry-card' (testID) on Rights tab is only rendered when primaryInterest.key === 'women' or 'domestic'; test user shows FIR card instead. Navigation to women-shield requires the home screen 'Start' button (no testID on that button) or direct URL
Direct URL navigation (/women/head-out) causes app restart but auth persists via AsyncStorage - app loads head-out screen correctly after language modal is dismissed
Language picker modal appears as overlay after URL navigation (app restart) - dismissing 'Continue in English' reveals the head-out screen underneath
Message preview correctly shows placeholder '[status link will be added]' - actual status URL is only fetched when user taps Send (POST /api/journey/status called at send time)
